title: Material Blend 3-Mix Trio #14 (부채꼴·매끈 / 동심원·물결 / 세로 띠·물결 | 목재+이레즈미+공작눈무늬 / 코이비늘+UV네온+인어비늘 / 뱀비늘+석재+인어비늘)

Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
